1.english_reference: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the LORD

traditions.WLC: הַ דָּבָ֛ר אֲשֶׁר הָיָ֥ה אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ מֵ אֵ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: Ὁ λόγος ὁ γενόμενος πρὸς Ἰερεμίαν παρὰ Κυρίου
traditions.VUL: Verbum , quod factum est ad Ieremíam a Dómino
traditions.KJV: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the LORD

1.english_reference: in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah ,

traditions.WLC: בִּ ימֵ֨י יְהוֹיָקִ֧ים בֶּן יֹאשִׁיָּ֛הוּ מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֖ה
traditions.LXX: ἐν ἡμέραις Ἰωακεὶμ βασιλέως Ἰούδα
traditions.VUL: in diébus Ióakim fílii Iosíæ regis Iuda ,
traditions.KJV: in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah ,

traditions.WLC: לֵ אמֹֽר
traditions.LXX: λέγων
traditions.VUL: dicens :
traditions.KJV: saying ,

2.english_reference: Go unto the house of the Rechabites ,

traditions.WLC: הָלוֹךְ֮ אֶל בֵּ֣ית הָ רֵכָבִים֒
traditions.LXX: Βάδισον εἰς οἶκον Ἁρχαβεὶν
traditions.VUL: Vade ad domum Rechabitárum ,
traditions.KJV: Go unto the house of the Rechabites ,

traditions.WLC: וְ דִבַּרְתָּ֣ אוֹתָ֔ ם
traditions.VUL: et lóquere eis ,
traditions.KJV: and speak unto them ,

2.english_reference: and bring them into the house of the LORD ,

traditions.WLC: וַ הֲבִֽאוֹתָ ם֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἄξεις αὐτοὺς εἰς οἶκον Κυρίου
traditions.VUL: et introdúces eos in domum Dómini ,
traditions.KJV: and bring them into the house of the LORD ,

traditions.WLC: אֶל אַחַ֖ת הַ לְּשָׁכ֑וֹת
traditions.LXX: εἰς μίαν τῶν αὐλῶν ,
traditions.VUL: in unam éxedram thesaurórum ,
traditions.KJV: into one of the chambers ,

2.english_reference: and give them wine to drink .

traditions.WLC: וְ הִשְׁקִיתָ֥ אוֹתָ֖ ם יָֽיִן
traditions.LXX: καὶ ποτιεῖς αὐτοὺς οἶνον .
traditions.VUL: et dabis eis bíbere vinum .
traditions.KJV: and give them wine to drink .

3.english_reference: Then I took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah , the son of Habaziniah ,

traditions.WLC: וָ אֶקַּ֞ח אֶת יַאֲזַנְיָ֤ה בֶֽן יִרְמְיָ֨הוּ֙ בֶּן חֲבַצִּנְיָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξήγαγον τὸν Ἰεχονίαν υἱὸν Ἰερεμὶν υἱοῦ Χαβασεὶν
traditions.VUL: Et assúmpsi Iezoníam fílium Ieremíæ fílii Habsaníæ ,
traditions.KJV: Then I took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah , the son of Habaziniah ,

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶת אֶחָ֖י
traditions.LXX: καὶ τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ
traditions.VUL: et fratres eius ,
traditions.KJV: and his brethren ,

traditions.WLC: ו וְ אֶת כָּל בָּנָ֑י
traditions.LXX: καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτοῦ
traditions.VUL: et omnes fílios eius ,
traditions.KJV: and all his sons ,

3.english_reference: and the whole house of the Rechabites ;

traditions.WLC: ו וְ אֵ֖ת כָּל בֵּ֥ית הָ רֵכָבִֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν οἰκίαν Ἁρχαβείν ,
traditions.VUL: et univérsam domum Rechabitárum :
traditions.KJV: and the whole house of the Rechabites ;

4.english_reference: And I brought them into the house of the LORD ,

traditions.WLC: וָ אָבִ֤א אֹתָ ם֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἰσήγαγον αὐτοὺς εἰς οἶκον Κυρίου
traditions.VUL: et introdúxi eos in domum Dómini ,
traditions.KJV: And I brought them into the house of the LORD ,

4.english_reference: into the chamber of the sons of Hanan , the son of Igdaliah , a man of God ,

traditions.WLC: אֶל לִשְׁכַּ֗ת בְּנֵ֛י חָנָ֥ן בֶּן יִגְדַּלְיָ֖הוּ אִ֣ישׁ הָ אֱלֹהִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: εἰς τὸ παστοφόριον υἱῶν Ἰωνὰν υἱοῦ Ἁνανίου υἱοῦ Γοδολίου ἀνθρώπου τοῦ θεοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: ad gazophylácium filiórum Hanan fílii Iegedelíæ hóminis Dei ,
traditions.KJV: into the chamber of the sons of Hanan , the son of Igdaliah , a man of God ,

4.english_reference: which [ was ] by the chamber of the princes ,

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁר אֵ֨צֶל֙ לִשְׁכַּ֣ת הַ שָּׂרִ֔ים
traditions.LXX: ὅς ἐστιν ἐγγὺς τοῦ οἴκου τῶν ἀρχόντων
traditions.VUL: quod erat iuxta gazophylácium príncipum ,
traditions.KJV: which [ was ] by the chamber of the princes ,

4.english_reference: which [ was ] above the chamber of Maaseiah the son of Shallum , the keeper of the door :

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֣ר מִ מַּ֗עַל לְ לִשְׁכַּ֛ת מַעֲשֵׂיָ֥הוּ בֶן שַׁלֻּ֖ם שֹׁמֵ֥ר הַ סַּֽף
traditions.LXX: τῶν ἐπάνω τοῦ οἴκου Μαασαίου υἱοῦ Σελὼμ τοῦ φυλάσσοντος τὴν αὐλήν .
traditions.VUL: super thesáurum Maasíæ fílii Sellum , qui erat custos vestíbuli .
traditions.KJV: which [ was ] above the chamber of Maaseiah the son of Shallum , the keeper of the door :

5.english_reference: And I set before the sons of the house of the Rechabites pots full of wine , and cups ,

traditions.WLC: וָ אֶתֵּ֞ן לִ פְנֵ֣י בְּנֵ֣י בֵית הָ רֵכָבִ֗ים גְּבִעִ֛ים מְלֵאִ֥ים יַ֖יִן וְ כֹס֑וֹת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔδωκα κατὰ πρόσωπον αὐτῶν κεράμιον οἴνου καὶ ποτήρια ,
traditions.VUL: Et pósui coram fíliis domus Rechabitárum scyphos plenos vino , et cálices ,
traditions.KJV: And I set before the sons of the house of the Rechabites pots full of wine , and cups ,

traditions.WLC: וָ אֹמַ֥ר אֲלֵי הֶ֖ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπα
traditions.VUL: et dixi ad eos :
traditions.KJV: and I said unto them ,

traditions.WLC: שְׁתוּ יָֽיִן
traditions.LXX: Πίετε οἶνον .
traditions.VUL: Bíbite vinum .
traditions.KJV: Drink ye wine .

6.english_reference: But they said , We will drink no wine :

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּאמְר֖וּ לֹ֣א נִשְׁתֶּה יָּ֑יִן
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπαν Οὐ μὴ πίωμεν οἶνον ,
traditions.VUL: Qui respondérunt : Non bibémus vinum ,
traditions.KJV: But they said , We will drink no wine :

6.english_reference: for Jonadab the son of Rechab our father commanded us , saying ,

traditions.WLC: כִּי֩ יוֹנָדָ֨ב בֶּן רֵכָ֜ב אָבִ֗י נוּ צִוָּ֤ה עָלֵ֨י נוּ֙ לֵ אמֹ֔ר
traditions.LXX: ὅτι Ἰωναδὰβ υἱὸς Ῥηχὰβ ὁ πατὴρ ἡμῶν ἐνετείλατο ἡμῖν λέγων
traditions.VUL: quia Iónadab fílius Rechab , pater noster , præcépit nobis , dicens :
traditions.KJV: for Jonadab the son of Rechab our father commanded us , saying ,

6.english_reference: Ye shall drink no wine , [ neither ] ye , nor your sons for ever :

traditions.WLC: לֹ֧א תִשְׁתּוּ יַ֛יִן אַתֶּ֥ם וּ בְנֵי כֶ֖ם עַד עוֹלָֽם
traditions.LXX: Οὐ μὴ πίητε οἶνον , ὑμεῖς καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ ὑμῶν ἕως αἰῶνος ,
traditions.VUL: Non bibétis vinum , vos et fílii vestri , usque in sempitérnum :
traditions.KJV: Ye shall drink no wine , [ neither ] ye , nor your sons for ever :

traditions.WLC: וּ בַ֣יִת לֹֽא תִבְנ֗וּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ οἰκίαν οὐ μὴ οἰκοδομήσητε ,
traditions.VUL: et domum non ædificábitis ,
traditions.KJV: Neither shall ye build house ,

traditions.WLC: וְ זֶ֤רַע לֹֽא תִזְרָ֨עוּ֙
traditions.LXX: καὶ σπέρμα οὐ μὴ σπείρητε ,
traditions.VUL: et seméntem non serétis ,
traditions.KJV: nor sow seed ,

traditions.WLC: וְ כֶ֣רֶם לֹֽא תִטָּ֔עוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀμπελὼν οὐκ ἔσται ὑμῖν ,
traditions.VUL: et víneas non plantábitis ,
traditions.KJV: nor plant vineyard ,

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹ֥א יִֽהְיֶ֖ה לָ כֶ֑ם
traditions.VUL: nec habébitis :
traditions.KJV: nor have [ any ] :

7.english_reference: but all your days ye shall dwell in tents ;

traditions.WLC: כִּ֠י בָּ אֳהָלִ֤ים תֵּֽשְׁבוּ֙ כָּל יְמֵי כֶ֔ם
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἐν σκηναῖς οἰκήσετε πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας ὑμῶν ,
traditions.VUL: sed in tabernáculis habitábitis cunctis diébus vestris ,
traditions.KJV: but all your days ye shall dwell in tents ;

7.english_reference: that ye may live many days in the land where ye [ be ] strangers .

traditions.WLC: לְמַ֨עַן תִּֽחְי֜וּ יָמִ֤ים רַבִּים֙ עַל פְּנֵ֣י הָ אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֖ם גָּרִ֥ים שָֽׁם
traditions.LXX: ὅπως ἂν ζήσητε ἡμέρας πολλὰς ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἐφ᾽ ἧς διατρίβετε ὑμεῖς ἐπ᾽ αὐτῆς .
traditions.VUL: ut vivátis diébus multis super fáciem terræ , in qua vos peregrinámini .
traditions.KJV: that ye may live many days in the land where ye [ be ] strangers .

8.english_reference: Thus have we obeyed the voice of Jonadab the son of Rechab our father in all that he hath charged us ,

traditions.WLC: וַ נִּשְׁמַ֗ע בְּ ק֨וֹל יְהוֹנָדָ֤ב בֶּן רֵכָב֙ אָבִ֔י נוּ לְ כֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֑ נוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἠκούσαμεν τῆς φωνῆς Ἰωναδὰβ τοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν
traditions.VUL: Obedívimus ergo voci Iónadab fílii Rechab , patris nostri , in ómnibus quæ præcépit nobis ,
traditions.KJV: Thus have we obeyed the voice of Jonadab the son of Rechab our father in all that he hath charged us ,

8.english_reference: to drink no wine all our days ,

traditions.WLC: לְ בִלְתִּ֤י שְׁתֽוֹת יַ֨יִן֙ כָּל יָמֵ֔י נוּ
traditions.LXX: πρὸς τὸ μὴ πιεῖν οἶνον πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας ἡμῶν ,
traditions.VUL: ita ut non biberémus vinum cunctis diébus nostris
traditions.KJV: to drink no wine all our days ,

8.english_reference: we , our wives , our sons , nor our daughters ;

traditions.WLC: אֲנַ֣חְנוּ נָשֵׁ֔י נוּ בָּנֵ֖י נוּ וּ בְנֹתֵֽי נוּ
traditions.LXX: ἡμεῖς καὶ αἱ γυναῖκες ἡμῶν καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ ἡμῶν καὶ αἱ θυγατέρες ἡμῶν ,
traditions.VUL: nos , et mulíeres nostræ , fílii , et fíliæ nostræ :
traditions.KJV: we , our wives , our sons , nor our daughters ;

9.english_reference: Nor to build houses for us to dwell in :

traditions.WLC: וּ לְ בִלְתִּ֛י בְּנ֥וֹת בָּתִּ֖ים לְ שִׁבְתֵּ֑ נוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ πρὸς τὸ μὴ οἰκοδομεῖν οἰκίας τοῦ κατοικεῖν ἐκεῖ ·
traditions.VUL: et non ædificarémus domos ad habitándum :
traditions.KJV: Nor to build houses for us to dwell in :

9.english_reference: neither have we vineyard , nor field , nor seed :

traditions.WLC: וְ כֶ֧רֶם וְ שָׂדֶ֛ה וָ זֶ֖רַע לֹ֥א יִֽהְיֶה לָּֽ נוּ
traditions.LXX: ἀμπελὼν καὶ ἀγρὸς καὶ σπέρμα οὐκ ἐγένετο ἡμῖν ·
traditions.VUL: et víneam , et agrum , et seméntem non habúimus :
traditions.KJV: neither have we vineyard , nor field , nor seed :

10.english_reference: But we have dwelt in tents ,

traditions.WLC: וַ נֵּ֖שֶׁב בָּֽ אֳהָלִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ᾠκήσαμεν ἐν σκηναῖς ,
traditions.VUL: sed habitávimus in tabernáculis ,
traditions.KJV: But we have dwelt in tents ,

10.english_reference: and have obeyed , and done according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us .

traditions.WLC: וַ נִּשְׁמַ֣ע וַ נַּ֔עַשׂ כְּ כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֖ נוּ יוֹנָדָ֥ב אָבִֽי נוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἠκούσαμεν καὶ ἐποιήσαμεν κατὰ πάντα ἃ ἐνετείλατο ἡμῖν Ἰωναδὰβ ὁ πατὴρ ἡμῶν .
traditions.VUL: et obediéntes fúimus iuxta ómnia , quæ præcépit nobis Iónadab pater noster .
traditions.KJV: and have obeyed , and done according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us .

11.english_reference: But it came to pass , when Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon came up into the land

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֗י בַּ עֲל֨וֹת נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶל֮ אֶל הָ אָרֶץ֒
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγενήθη ὅτε ἀνέβη Ναβουχοδονοσὸρ ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν ,
traditions.VUL: Cum autem ascendísset Nabuchodónosor rex Babylónis ad terram nostram ,
traditions.KJV: But it came to pass , when Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon came up into the land ,

11.english_reference: that we said , Come , and let us go to Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: וַ נֹּ֗אמֶר בֹּ֚אוּ וְ נָב֣וֹא יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἴπαμεν εἰσελθεῖν , καὶ εἰσήλθομεν εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ
traditions.VUL: díximus : Veníte , et ingrediámur Ierúsalem
traditions.KJV: that we said , Come , and let us go to Jerusalem

11.english_reference: for fear of the army of the Chaldeans , and for fear of the army of the Syrians

traditions.WLC: מִ פְּנֵי֙ חֵ֣יל הַ כַּשְׂדִּ֔ים וּ מִ פְּנֵ֖י חֵ֣יל אֲרָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: ἀπὸ προσώπου τῆς δυνάμεως τῶν Χαλδαίων καὶ ἀπὸ προσώπου τῆς δυνάμεως τῶν Ἀσσυρίων ,
traditions.VUL: a fácie exércitus Chaldæórum , et a fácie exércitus Sýriæ :
traditions.KJV: for fear of the army of the Chaldeans , and for fear of the army of the Syrians :

traditions.WLC: וַ נֵּ֖שֶׁב בִּ ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ᾠκοῦμεν ἐκεῖ .
traditions.VUL: et mánsimus in Ierúsalem .
traditions.KJV: so we dwell at Jerusalem .

12.english_reference: Then came the word of the LORD unto Jeremiah , saying

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יְהִי֙ דְּבַר יְהוָ֔ה אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ לֵ אמֹֽר
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος Κυρίου πρὸς μὲ λέγων .
traditions.VUL: Et factum est verbum Dómini ad Ieremíam , dicens :
traditions.KJV: Then came the word of the LORD unto Jeremiah , saying ,

13.english_reference: Thus saith the LORD of hosts , the God of Israel

traditions.WLC: כֹּֽה אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל
traditions.LXX: Οὕτως λέγει Κύριος
traditions.VUL: Hæc dicit Dóminus exercítuum , Deus Israel :
traditions.KJV: Thus saith the LORD of hosts , the God of Israel ;

13.english_reference: Go and tell the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: הָלֹ֤ךְ וְ אָֽמַרְתָּ֙ לְ אִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָ֔ה וּ לְ יֽוֹשְׁבֵ֖י יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: Πορεύου καὶ εἰπὸν ἀνθρώπῳ Ἰούδα καὶ τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν Ἰερουσαλήμ
traditions.VUL: Vade , et dic viris Iuda et habitatóribus Ierúsalem :
traditions.KJV: Go and tell the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem ,

13.english_reference: Will ye not receive instruction to hearken to my words ? saith the LORD

traditions.WLC: הֲ ל֨וֹא תִקְח֥וּ מוּסָ֛ר לִ שְׁמֹ֥עַ אֶל דְּבָרַ֖ י נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: Οὐ μὴ λάβητε παιδίαν τοῦ ἀκούειν τοὺς λόγους μου ;
traditions.VUL: Numquid non recipiétis disciplínam , ut obediátis verbis meis , dicit Dóminus ?
traditions.KJV: Will ye not receive instruction to hearken to my words ? saith the LORD .

14.english_reference: The words of Jonadab the son of Rechab , that he commanded his sons not to drink wine , are performed

traditions.WLC: הוּקַ֡ם אֶת דִּבְרֵ֣י יְהוֹנָדָ֣ב בֶּן רֵ֠כָב אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֨ה אֶת בָּנָ֜י ו לְ בִלְתִּ֣י שְׁתֽוֹת יַ֗יִן
traditions.LXX: ἔστησαν ῥῆμα υἱοὶ Ἰωναδὰβ υἱοῦ Ῥηχάβ , ὃ ἐνετείλατο τοῖς τέκνοις αὐτοῦ πρὸς τὸ μὴ πιεῖν οἶνον ,
traditions.VUL: Prævaluérunt sermónes Iónadab fílii Rechab , quos præcépit fíliis suis ut non bíberent vinum :
traditions.KJV: The words of Jonadab the son of Rechab , that he commanded his sons not to drink wine , are performed ;

14.english_reference: for unto this day they drink none , but obey their father ’s commandment

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹ֤א שָׁתוּ֙ עַד הַ יּ֣וֹם הַ זֶּ֔ה כִּ֣י שָֽׁמְע֔וּ אֵ֖ת מִצְוַ֣ת אֲבִי הֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ἐπίοσαν ·
traditions.VUL: et non bibérunt usque ad diem hanc , quia obediérunt præcépto patris sui :
traditions.KJV: for unto this day they drink none , but obey their father ’s commandment :

14.english_reference: notwithstanding I have spoken unto you , rising early and speaking
